# Plain Markdown workflow fixtures

These small authored examples exercise familiar Spec Kit and OpenSpec document shapes. They are compatibility fixtures, not copies of either project's templates or promises of CLI integration.

- [GitHub Spec Kit](https://github.com/github/spec-kit): user stories, requirements, success criteria and linked tasks.
- [OpenSpec](https://github.com/Fission-AI/OpenSpec): added/modified requirements, scenarios and task checklists.

Keep ordinary headings, links and GFM tasks. Do not add proprietary syntax, runtime dependencies or an agent orchestration layer.
